title: Fennel Slipstream
description: A descending melody drifts over three unequal breaths in each bar. The accompaniment alternates E and G with a recurring F-major window, while a five-bar song gradually acquires small rising answers. A central brightening gives way to a lower, more spacious return and an open sixth.
technical_note: Shape the 9/8 as a flexible long phrase. LH dotted-quarter anchors alternate with short paired notes, and the RH ties ignore some bar lines. Keep the late octave descent connected without accenting it; the final sixth has no extra fermata.

performance.note: Authored phrase breathing and independent note lengths; no random timing offsets.

composition_time_source: Recorded when the first score was saved.

audio_reverb.description: Subtle warm room; preserve the clarity of moving voices.
